projects.title: Event Marketplace
projects.description: A Java Swing desktop application for university event management, ticket purchasing, and QR-based ticket scanning.

projects.title: Receipt Scanner
projects.description: An intelligent Streamlit web application that uses the Gemini 2.5 Flash multimodal model to scan receipt images and automatically populate an editable web form with the extracted data.

projects.title: Parking Lot Management System
projects.description: A Java Swing desktop application featuring a custom GUI for revenue and occupancy tracking, automated data flow visualization, and unpaid fine management built on scalable architecture design patterns.

projects.title: Multiplayer Hybrid Concurrency Game
projects.description: A concurrent logging system featuring atomic updates and signal handling to ensure thread-safe data persistence and game scoring.

projects.title: Robot Battlefield Simulator
projects.description: A grid-based simulation application utilizing class inheritance for specialized robots, featuring a custom battlefield manager and turn execution engine for movement validation and real-time event logging.

projects.title: Hostel Management System (HORECA)
projects.description: A web-based maintenance management system for hostel damages featuring an automated PHP email notification module to provide real-time ticket status updates to complainants and administrators.

projects.title: Ramadan Guide
projects.description: A collaborative frontend website designed for optimal user experience, featuring interactive Google Maps integration to pin and filter mosques based on user preferences.

aboutpara: A dedicated Software Engineering student with experience in software testing and development. Focused on building reliable systems using PHP and C++, supported by intermediate certifications and hands-on internship experience. Successfully applied design patterns and concurrency models to complex academic projects. Committed to continuous self-improvement, solving technical problems and collaborating in diverse team environments. Trilingual in Malay, English and German. Seeking an internship opportunity from 27th July - 18th October 2026.

resume.tagline: I'm a student of software engineering, designer, and sometimes can be a tester too (when things get tough).
resume.description: I believe every jobs and careers are beneficial to everyone. And it is actually my one and only dream to develop a system that can help people in their daily life.
